name: Marcus 'ViperMain24' Vance
bio: 27-year-old former Tier 2 Controller main. Aim took a dip, but macro understanding, post-plant setups, and smoke protocol are sharper than ever. Specializes in turning disorganized teams into site-retake masters.

name: Sarah 'AimDecay99' Chen
bio: Former collegiate captain who transitioned to tactical directing. Focuses on mid-round calling, economy discipline, and utility combos. Great with vocal leadership drills for quiet squads.

name: Devon 'BoomerIGL' Brooks
bio: 28 years old, CS:GO veteran turned Valorant anti-strat guru. Analyzes competitor VODs, maps default tendencies, and builds tailored counter-utility playbooks for tournament weekends.

name: Leon 'OldManSova' Miller
bio: Specialist in recon-first executes and info-denial setups. Teaches young rosters how to stop face-checking angles and coordinate drone/flash trading.

name: Elena 'SmokesDad' Reyes
bio: Deep knowledge of high-tempo Astra stars and Omen one-way timings. Excellent for teams struggling on Ascent, Haven, and Lotus defense setups.

name: Kenji 'TacticalPanda' Sato
bio: Master of site lockdown mechanics and micro-flank positioning. Known for crafting custom playbook notes and rigorous scrim analysis.
